name: Minikui Orc ga, Chou Sugoi Saiminjutsu o Mi ni Tsukechaimashita!
original_name: 醜いオークが、超スゴイ催眠術を身につけちゃいました！
source:
Imagine a fantasy RPG world where a hypnotist could rule all...
Become that hypnotist possessing the body of powerful orc...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE085331.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
想象一下，在一个奇幻角色扮演游戏的世界里，催眠师足以支配一切……
成为那名催眠师，占据强壮兽人的身体……
